summary: The standing debrief fold now reviews Nora's own finished exchange in the first person instead of being cast as a third-person observer — the observer cast had no position to revise, so the fold produced transcript recaps instead of positions.
details: The fold was cast as a third-person observer ("You are not the assistant who answered it") while the render note and outcome gloss spoke of "you"/"her" inconsistently — one fold saw three conflicting referents.

The objective now addresses the fold as Nora reviewing her own finished exchange (first person for the position, "your turn" for the verdict — impartiality is architectural per 26-standing §1, a different call, not a prompt cast), the outcome gloss speaks in "you", and the REVISE paragraph tells the fold to re-voice inherited third-person clauses as "I" so the mixed-voice transition after deploy does not produce mixed-person paragraphs.

Person-contract tests lock the cast on both the objective (via the shipped-objectives seam, not read_text) and the gloss. Issue #78 Phase 1; the structural split of standing revision from the groundedness verdict is Phase 2 and deliberately not in this change.
